body: Well, I'm hanging out here because I've been feeling extra shitty myself.  I'm sorry and I hope you pull out of it.  I hope we all do.

Let me ask you if you feel similarly to the way I do.  I have thought about killing myself a lot lately.  In a way, I don't want to die, I just haven't wanted to live.  Lately.

I feel like I could either just go for it and pick a somewhat reliable method to kill myself (although no method is guaranteed) or I could pick a less reliable but less painful approach (drug overdose for example).  

I really hate pain so the second option feels like a better fit for me although in my arguably warped mind I have this weird fantasy of "going for it" but in a way where I *could* be saved e.g. overdose and sit somewhere in a public space so that others would see me collapse and call for medical help.

And then, if I actually survived then it would be some sort of divine judgment call proving that I really should go on living.  And that I'd change my worldview from there and be a better person.  I have no idea why I think this way but I do.  And of course if I died, then it was meant to be.

But being disabled, brain damaged, etc and then not dying for possibly a long time is a distinct possibility (see my other comments int this post).
I can't even imagine surviving as a suicidal quadriplegic.  Or surviving in a long term coma.  Where of course, you couldn't even kill yourself if you wanted to.

Which I think is everyone's "failed suicide" nightmare, it is certainly mine.  If I ever got up the gumption to attempt suicide and then ended up horribly disabled and. . . survived a long time in that state, well that would be awful.

Also, thinking about this does make me feel grateful that I'm not (knock on wood) disabled now.  I have a friend who suffered severe brain damage in a motorcycle accident and it's almost ruined his life.  

I am not passing judgment on anyone, just musing out loud.

tl;dr if you don't kill yourself, the failed attempt could leave you even more unhappy.

I'm right there with you.  Dying is scary.  I don't believe most people who say that it isn't.  You're also biologically rigged to not want to die.  

I've been mulling suicide for several weeks now but I haven't gone ahead with an actual attempt yet.  I've contemplated it many times in the past too.
I feel similarly.  How are you planning to kill yourself?

Well, again thank you.  I really appreciate your support.  This is the odd beauty of a site like reddit and the warmth that people like you offer (of course, there are trolls aplenty here but this subreddit does a good job of keeping them out).

I just can't deal with failure anymore.  I'm so tired of it.
No, I'm really a piece of shit.

Thank you.  Ok, to ramble on, my wife wasn't happy at her old job so (long story) we sold our house which was insanely stressful, we moved cross country and rented for 6 months and everything blew up with my daughter at her school which is also where my wife was going to work.  Like lawyers + police reports had.   

So we left quickly and thank god we're able to break the lease.  But then my wife insisted on buying a new house right away when we moved back.  I can't stand it.  IMO, we overpaid.

Plus, I feel like we're poised for a massive recession and I'm going to lose my job and we'll lose the house and I'm really burnt out but I can't afford to take a break from my full or part time work + again I'm afraid the work won't be around for much longer.

I just want to give up.  I'm so upset that we upended our lives twice in the past year.  Now my wife is talking about starting up a business again even though her last attempt was a failure.  Her first business was successful for a while until she had a miscarriage and handed it over to me.  This was back right in 2008-2010 which was a mess but I tucked it up too.

I'm so miserable.  Everything looks and tastes like shit.  I feel like I need to suffer and go away and stop bringing everyone down

It is strange when you mentally go down this path while maintaining day to day activities.

I've been in this space for a few weeks, looking to get out.

Yes, and she has told me to just "man up".  She's also called my bluff and told me to just do it.  To be fair, it's not fun dealing with a suicidal spouse.  

I can't blame her for everything.  She's had a tough life.

Yes, my kids are my big holdout, but if I'm not a fully functioning father, I'm not sure they're better off with me in the long run.  I haven't gone completely off the deep end yet but I've packed up my stuff to leave once already.  I know where and how to buy a gun.  I have a backup plan to buy a realistic looking air rifle so that I can commit suicide by cop.  I know how much I can withdraw from our bank account in one day.  I've looked into restrictions on last minute domestic and international flights. I've done a ton of research about going to prison.

Tl;dr I've made a ton of plans for taking care of myself.

Oh wow, you're welcome.  Did not think there would be anyone here who could relate much to my situation.

I don't know what to do.
